raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-ALB-CitizenServiceDelivery",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "ADISA and the new PMU have very weak procurement capacity, risking non‑compliant purchases and delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit experienced procurement staff, provide Bank‑led training, use sample TORs, and maintain close Bank oversight during early procurement cycles.",
      "evidence": "Very weak procurement capacity at ADISA as a newly created agency. (Procurement risk rating section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Failure to achieve DLI#5 (policy reform document and baseline survey) will block all RBF disbursements.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize DLI#5 early, allocate PPF funds for the baseline survey, set a strict timeline, and monitor progress weekly.",
      "evidence": "No disbursements under RBF will be made until DLI#5 is achieved. (Disbursement conditions)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Complex inter‑ministerial coordination may cause delays or inconsistent implementation of reforms.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen the Steering Committee, hold regular joint meetings, define clear TORs for Working Groups, and use the DU as a coordination hub.",
      "evidence": "Complex coordination... multiple lead agencies... risk of bureaucratic resistance. (Coordination section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Seven key agencies lack any IT system, hindering backend automation and service digitisation.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Fast‑track IT development with TA support, adopt a phased rollout, and ensure NAIS provides integration assistance.",
      "evidence": "Seven institutions encompassed by the proposed project have no IT system in place. (Component 1 description)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Low internet penetration may exclude poor and vulnerable groups from e‑services, undermining equity goals.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain physical CSCs, create assisted access points (internet cafés, community centres), and run targeted outreach campaigns.",
      "evidence": "Risk that focus on state‑of‑the‑art means could diminish access of the poor and vulnerable. (Section 6)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Construction of the central CSC could generate dust, noise, waste and traffic impacts.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement the Environmental Management Plan, enforce construction best practices, obtain required permits, and monitor impacts continuously.",
      "evidence": "Potential environmental impacts... dust and noise, waste generation... mitigated through EMP. (Environment section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Entrenched corruption and staff resistance may impede reform of front‑office processes.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy a change‑management program, provide ethics training, link performance incentives to citizen‑feedback results, and monitor via the feedback mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Corruption remains high... risk of resistance to reforms. (Corruption survey section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Overall financial management risk is substantial due to ADISA’s limited fiduciary experience.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire two qualified finance specialists, adopt a detailed Financial Management Manual, and conduct regular Bank‑led training and audits.",
      "evidence": "Overall financial management risk is rated as Substantial... ADISA has limited experience. (Financial Management section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Unfilled procurement and administrative specialist positions delay procurement planning and execution.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Accelerate recruitment, use interim staff or consultants, and leverage Bank procurement experts for early guidance.",
      "evidence": "Procurement and Administrative Specialist positions have been readvertised... PMU not yet fully set up. (Procurement risk section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "The project’s ambitious timeline (CSC by 2017, reforms by 2020) may lead to missed milestones.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed work plan with buffer periods, track milestones monthly, and apply results‑based incentives to keep teams on schedule.",
      "evidence": "Government’s timeline is very ambitious... compressed implementation timeline is a potential risk. (Sustainability section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Administrative data may not capture the true time citizens spend obtaining services, compromising performance measurement.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Triangulate administrative data with citizen surveys, improve data capture at service points, and conduct periodic data quality audits.",
      "evidence": "Administrative data does not reflect citizens’ experience... may not account for time gathering documents. (PDO Indicator description)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Operating costs of the CSC may exceed estimates, threatening fiscal sustainability.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Perform a detailed OPEX analysis, set a reserve fund, review costs annually, and explore PPP financing for non‑core services.",
      "evidence": "Operating costs for the CSC will likely be offset... ongoing operating costs include licenses and maintenance. (Financial analysis section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Shifts in EU accession priorities could reduce political support for the reform programme.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Align reform outcomes with EU standards, maintain regular dialogue with EU partners, and embed reforms in the National Strategy for Development.",
      "evidence": "EU progress report acknowledges political will... challenges ahead of EU accession. (EU section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Inadequate communication may lead to low citizen awareness and trust, limiting uptake of new services.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Launch a multi‑channel communication campaign, involve grassroots organisations, and monitor awareness through the citizen feedback mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Effective communication is critical... to improve citizens’ trust and perception. (Communication section)"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Delays in DLI verification and reporting could postpone RBF disbursements.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a clear verification protocol, schedule third‑party validations ahead of reporting deadlines, and train PMU staff on timely IFR preparation.",
      "evidence": "DLIs will be verified each calendar quarter... verification protocol provided in Annex 1. (Disbursement section)"
    }
  ]
}
